#Defining Functions

```{r KZFP_enrichment_function}
KZFP_enrichment <- function(comparisons, TopTable, KZFPs_list) {
  
  results <- lapply(comparisons, function(group) {
    
    test_genes <- TopTable %>%
      filter(Comparisons == group) %>%
      distinct(Symbol)
    
    deg_genes <- TopTable %>%
      filter(Comparisons == group,
             adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
      distinct(Symbol)
    
    not_deg_genes <- setdiff(test_genes$Symbol, deg_genes$Symbol)
    
    tab <- matrix(
      c(
        sum(deg_genes$Symbol %in% KZFPs_list),
        sum(deg_genes$Symbol %notin% KZFPs_list),
        sum(not_deg_genes %in% KZFPs_list),
        sum(not_deg_genes %notin% KZFPs_list)
      ),
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
    
    fisher <- fisher.test(tab)
    
    data.frame(
      Comparison = group,
      KZFP_DEG = tab[1,1],
      NonKZFP_DEG = tab[1,2],
      KZFP_not_DEG = tab[2,1],
      NonKZFP_not_DEG = tab[2,2],
      Odds_Ratio = fisher$estimate,
      Fisher_p = fisher$p.value
    )
  })
  
  do.call(rbind, results)
}
```


```{r KZFP_enrichment_fate_function}
Fate_KZFP_enrichment <- function(comparisons, TopTable_Fate, KZFPs_list) {
  
  results <- lapply(comparisons, function(group) {
    
    test_genes <- TopTable_Fate %>%
      filter(Comparisons == group) %>%
      distinct(Symbol, Fate)
    
    
    fate_tests <- list(
      Specific = "Specific",
      Shared_partial = "Shared_partial",
      Shared_all = "Shared_all"
    )
    
    
    do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fate_tests), function(fate_name) {
      
      fate_genes <- test_genes %>%
        filter(Fate == fate_tests[[fate_name]]) %>%
        pull(Symbol)
      
      non_fate_genes <- test_genes %>%
        filter(Fate != fate_tests[[fate_name]]) %>%
        pull(Symbol)
      
      
      tab <- matrix(
        c(
          sum(fate_genes %in% KZFPs_list),
          sum(fate_genes %notin% KZFPs_list),
          sum(non_fate_genes %in% KZFPs_list),
          sum(non_fate_genes %notin% KZFPs_list)
        ),
        nrow = 2,
        byrow = TRUE
      )
      
      fisher <- fisher.test(tab)
      
      data.frame(
        Comparison = group,
        Fate = fate_name,
        KZFP_Fate = tab[1,1],
        NonKZFP_Fate = tab[1,2],
        KZFP_nonFate = tab[2,1],
        NonKZFP_nonFate = tab[2,2],
        Odds_Ratio = fisher$estimate,
        Fisher_p = fisher$p.value
      )
      
    }))
  })
  
  do.call(rbind, results)
}

```

```{r FischerTest_OddsRation_plotting}
plot_OR <- function(results, group_to_plot, ylim = c(-2, 2)) {

  plot_data <- results %>%
    filter(Comparison_Group %in% group_to_plot) %>%
    mutate(
      label = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, "*", ""),
      log2_OR = log2(Odds_Ratio)
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(Comparison, log2_OR)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      vjust = -1
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}
```


```{r FischerTest_fate_OddsRation_plotting}

plot_Fate_OR <- function(results, ylim = c(-2, 2)) {

  plot_data <- results %>%
    mutate(
      label = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, "*", ""),
      log2_OR = log2(Odds_Ratio)
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Comparison, y = log2_OR)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      vjust = -1
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~Fate) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "HvC developmental comparison",
      y = "log2 Odds Ratio",
      title = "KZFP enrichment by HvC DEG fate"
    )
}
```

```{r KZFP,fig.height=4, fig.width=7}
  comparisons,
  TopTable,
  KZFPs_list
)

KZFP_results$FDR <- p.adjust(KZFP_results$Fisher_p, method = "BH")

KZFP_results

comparison_order <- c(
  "HvC_Day0",
  "HvC_Day2",
  "HvC_Day5",
  "HvC_Day15",
  "HvC_Day30",
  "H_Day02",
  "H_Day25",
  "H_Day515",
  "H_Day1530",
  "C_Day02",
  "C_Day25",
  "C_Day515",
  "C_Day1530",
```

```{r KZFP_FC}
KZFPs_list <- readRDS("data/TEs/KZFPs_list.RDS")

comparisons <- unique(TopTable$Comparisons)

comparison_order <- c(
  "HvC_Day0",
  "HvC_Day2",
  "HvC_Day5",
  "HvC_Day15",
  "HvC_Day30",
  "H_Day02",
  "H_Day25",
  "H_Day515",
  "H_Day1530",
  "C_Day02",
  "C_Day25",
  "C_Day515",
  "C_Day1530",
  "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj02",
  "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj25",
  "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj515",
  "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj1530"
)

KZFP_all <- TopTable %>%
  filter(
    Comparisons %in% comparison_order,
    Symbol %in% KZFPs_list
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Comparisons = factor(
      Comparisons,
      levels = comparison_order
    )
  )

# saveRDS(KZFP_all,"data/TEs/KZFPs_Toptable.RDS")

ggplot(KZFP_all, aes(Comparisons, logFC)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

KZFP_FC <- TopTable %>%
  filter(
    Comparisons %in% comparisons,
    Symbol %in% KZFPs_list
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Comparisons, Symbol, logFC, adj.P.Val)

KZFP_DEG <- TopTable %>%
  filter(
    Comparisons %in% comparisons,
    Symbol %in% KZFPs_list,
    adj.P.Val < 0.05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Comparisons, Symbol, logFC, adj.P.Val)

KZFP_DEG %>%
  filter(grepl("^HvC", Comparisons)) %>%
  arrange(Comparisons, desc(logFC))

KZFP_DEG_direction <- KZFP_DEG %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = case_when(
      
      # Species contrasts
      grepl("^HvC", Comparisons) & logFC > 0 ~ "Higher in Human",
      grepl("^HvC", Comparisons) & logFC < 0 ~ "Higher in Chimp",
      
      # Human trajectory contrasts
      grepl("^H_Day", Comparisons) & logFC > 0 ~ "Human increased",
      grepl("^H_Day", Comparisons) & logFC < 0 ~ "Human decreased",
      
      # Chimp trajectory contrasts
      grepl("^C_Day", Comparisons) & logFC > 0 ~ "Chimp increased",
      grepl("^C_Day", Comparisons) & logFC < 0 ~ "Chimp decreased",
      
      # Species x trajectory interactions
      grepl("^Sig_Sp_inter", Comparisons) & logFC > 0 ~ "Human-Chimp difference increased",
      grepl("^Sig_Sp_inter", Comparisons) & logFC < 0 ~ "Human-Chimp difference decreased",
      
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Comparisons, Direction)
```

```{r KZFP_alluvial,fig.height=5,fig.width=5}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_Symbols_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_NoRep_No4.RDS")
KZFPs_list <- readRDS("data/TEs/KZFPs_list.RDS")

comparisons <- unique(TopTable$Comparisons)

comparison_order <- c(
  "HvC_Day0",
  "HvC_Day2",
  "HvC_Day5",
  "HvC_Day15",
  "HvC_Day30",
  "H_Day02",
  "H_Day25",
  "H_Day515",
  "H_Day1530",
  "C_Day02",
  "C_Day25",
  "C_Day515",
  "C_Day1530",
  "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj02",
  "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj25",
  "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj515",
  "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj1530"
)


KZFP_alluvial <- TopTable %>%
  filter(
    Symbol %in% KZFPs_list,
    Comparisons %in% comparison_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = case_when(
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    Comparison_Group = case_when(
      grepl("^HvC", Comparisons) ~ "Species",
      grepl("^H_Day", Comparisons) ~ "Human",
      grepl("^C_Day", Comparisons) ~ "Chimp",
      grepl("^Sig_Sp_inter", Comparisons) ~ "Interaction",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    Comparisons = factor(
      Comparisons,
      levels = comparison_order
    )
  )

plot_KZFP_alluvial <- function(data, group_to_plot) {
  
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(Comparison_Group == group_to_plot)
  
  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Comparisons,
      stratum = Direction,
      alluvium = Symbol,
      y = 1,
      fill = Direction
    )
  ) +
    geom_alluvium(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_stratum() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of KZFPs",
      title = group_to_plot
    )
}

  KZFP_alluvial,
  "Species"
)

Human_plot <- plot_KZFP_alluvial(

)

Chimp_plot <- plot_KZFP_alluvial(

Interaction_plot <- plot_KZFP_alluvial(

)
```

```{r, fig.height=7,fig.width=7}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/TEs/KZFPs_Toptable.RDS")
RNA_sets <- readRDS("data/DGE/RNA_sets_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_NoRep_No4.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

timepoints <- c("Day0","Day2","Day5","Day15","Day30")

df <- TopTable %>%
  filter(str_detect(Comparisons, "^HvC_Day")) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = str_extract(Comparisons, "Day[0-9]+"),
    DEG = adj.P.Val < 0.05
  ) %>%
  filter(DEG)

genes_list <- list(
  Day0  = df %>% filter(Time == "Day0") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day2  = df %>% filter(Time == "Day2") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day5  = df %>% filter(Time == "Day5") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day15 = df %>% filter(Time == "Day15") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day30 = df %>% filter(Time == "Day30") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()
)

ggVennDiagram(genes_list, label = "count") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


df <- TopTable %>%
  filter(str_detect(Comparisons, "^HvC_Day")) %>%
  mutate(
    Stage = str_extract(Comparisons, "Day[0-9]+"),
    DEG = adj.P.Val < 0.05
  ) %>%
  filter(DEG)

genes <- list(
  Day0  = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day0") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day2  = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day2") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day5  = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day5") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day15 = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day15") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day30 = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day30") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()
)

days <- names(genes)

shared_all <- Reduce(intersect, genes)

get_fate <- function(day) {

  g <- genes[[day]]

  specific <- setdiff(
    g,
    unlist(genes[names(genes) != day])
  )

  shared_all_day <- intersect(
    g,
    shared_all
  )

  shared_partial <- setdiff(
    setdiff(g, specific),
    shared_all_day
  )

  data.frame(
    Day = day,
    Specific = length(specific),
    Shared_partial = length(shared_partial),
    Shared_all = length(shared_all_day)
  )
}

plot_df <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(genes), get_fate)
)

library(tidyr)

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Specific, Shared_partial, Shared_all),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Count"
  )

plot_long$Day <- factor(
  plot_long$Day,
  levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day5","Day15","Day30")
)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = Day, y = Count, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Specific" = "#D55E00",
    "Shared_partial" = "#0072B2",
    "Shared_all" = "#009E73"
  )) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Developmental stage",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = "",
    title = "Fate of HvC KZFP DEGs across development"
  )


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

plot_long_prop <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Specific, Shared_partial, Shared_all),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  mutate(
    Prop = Count / sum(Count)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_long_prop$Day <- factor(
  plot_long_prop$Day,
  levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day5","Day15","Day30")
)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(plot_long_prop, aes(x = Day, y = Prop, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Specific" = "#D55E00",
    "Shared_partial" = "#0072B2",
    "Shared_all" = "#009E73"
  )) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Developmental stage",
    y = "Proportion of DEGs",
    fill = "",
    title = "Fate of HvC KZFP DEGs across development (normalized)"
  )

```



```{r,fig.height=7,fig.width=7}
KZFP_Toptable <- readRDS("data/TEs/KZFPs_Toptable.RDS")
RNA_sets <- readRDS("data/DGE/RNA_sets_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_NoRep_No4.RDS")
KZFPs_list <- readRDS("data/TEs/KZFPs_list.RDS")

H_comp <- "H_Day02"
C_comp <- "C_Day02"

df_wide <- KZFP_Toptable %>%
  filter(Comparisons %in% c(H_comp, C_comp)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Comparisons, logFC) %>%
  group_by(Gene, Comparisons) %>%
  summarize(logFC = mean(logFC), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Comparisons, values_from = logFC) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[H_comp]]), !is.na(.data[[C_comp]]))

# head(df_wide)
# nrow(df_wide)

fit <- lm(df_wide[[C_comp]] ~ df_wide[[H_comp]])
summary(fit)

r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
pval <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]

# r2
# pval

format(pval, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)

library(ggplot2)

x_pos <- max(df_wide[[H_comp]]) * 0.95      # right side
x_neg <- min(df_wide[[H_comp]]) * 0.5      # left side

y_pos <- max(df_wide[[C_comp]]) * 0.95

# Optional: make axes symmetric around 0 for a nicer visual

x_limits <- c(-4, 4)
y_limits <- c(-4, 4)
max_val <- max(abs(c(x_limits, y_limits)))

genes_of_interest_human <- unique(RNA_sets$H_Day02$DEGs$Gene)
genes_of_interest_chimp <- unique(RNA_sets$C_Day02$DEGs$Gene)

df_wide$highlight <- dplyr::case_when(
  df_wide$Gene %in% genes_of_interest_human &
  df_wide$Gene %in% genes_of_interest_chimp ~ "T-DEG Both",

  df_wide$Gene %in% genes_of_interest_human ~ "T-DEG Human Only",

  df_wide$Gene %in% genes_of_interest_chimp ~ "T-DEG Chimp Only",

  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

# Plot
ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = .data[[H_comp]], y = .data[[C_comp]], color = highlight)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T-DEG Human Only" = "red", "T-DEG Chimp Only" = "blue", "T-DEG Both" = "purple", "Other" = "grey70")) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(df_wide[[H_comp]], na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(df_wide[[C_comp]], na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0(
      "R² = ", round(r2, 3),
      "\np = ", format(pval, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = H_comp,
    y = C_comp,
    title = paste0(H_comp, " vs ", C_comp),
    color = "Gene Set"
  )


```

```{r}
KZFP_Toptable <- readRDS("data/TEs/KZFPs_Toptable.RDS")
RNA_sets <- readRDS("data/DGE/RNA_sets_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_NoRep_No4.RDS")

H_comp <- "H_Day25"
C_comp <- "C_Day25"

df_wide <- KZFP_Toptable %>%
  filter(Comparisons %in% c(H_comp, C_comp)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Comparisons, logFC) %>%
  group_by(Gene, Comparisons) %>%
  summarize(logFC = mean(logFC), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Comparisons, values_from = logFC) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[H_comp]]), !is.na(.data[[C_comp]]))

# head(df_wide)
# nrow(df_wide)

fit <- lm(df_wide[[C_comp]] ~ df_wide[[H_comp]])
summary(fit)

r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
pval <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]

# r2
# pval

format(pval, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)

library(ggplot2)

x_pos <- max(df_wide[[H_comp]]) * 0.95      # right side
x_neg <- min(df_wide[[H_comp]]) * 0.5      # left side

y_pos <- max(df_wide[[C_comp]]) * 0.95

# Optional: make axes symmetric around 0 for a nicer visual

x_limits <- c(-4, 4)
y_limits <- c(-4, 4)
max_val <- max(abs(c(x_limits, y_limits)))

genes_of_interest_human <- unique(RNA_sets$H_Day25$DEGs$Gene)
genes_of_interest_chimp <- unique(RNA_sets$C_Day25$DEGs$Gene)

df_wide$highlight <- dplyr::case_when(
  df_wide$Gene %in% genes_of_interest_human &
  df_wide$Gene %in% genes_of_interest_chimp ~ "T-DEG Both",

  df_wide$Gene %in% genes_of_interest_human ~ "T-DEG Human Only",

  df_wide$Gene %in% genes_of_interest_chimp ~ "T-DEG Chimp Only",

  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

# Plot
ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = .data[[H_comp]], y = .data[[C_comp]], color = highlight)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T-DEG Human Only" = "red", "T-DEG Chimp Only" = "blue", "T-DEG Both" = "purple", "Other" = "grey70")) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(df_wide[[H_comp]], na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(df_wide[[C_comp]], na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0(
      "R² = ", round(r2, 3),
      "\np = ", format(pval, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = H_comp,
    y = C_comp,
    title = paste0(H_comp, " vs ", C_comp),
    color = "Gene Set"
  )


```
